title: RegisterPatientRequest
description: Body of POST /api/patients. Shape, length and format only - meaning stays with the Patient aggregate.

mrn.description: Medical Record Number, unique per facility. Surrounding whitespace is tolerated deliberately: the aggregate trims and upper-cases, so a padded MRN must reach it and come back 409 rather than 400. The pattern and maxLength agree at 64 characters on purpose - a frontend generated from this document sets maxlength=64 on the input, and a shorter pattern would 400 a value the input let the user type.

dateOfBirth.description: The pattern carries the 1875 floor, which JSON Schema cannot express as a date comparison. There is deliberately no upper bound here: 'not in the future' is compared against the injected clock in Patient.Register, and a static schema would bake in a build-time date.
